# Lapa Casa

> Boutique hostel and private apartments in Santa Teresa, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Direct booking, specializing in group stays with automatic group discounts. Address: Rua Silvio Romero 22, Santa Teresa, Rio de Janeiro. Phone/WhatsApp: +55 21 97715-7530.

Lapa Casa offers two independent booking flows on the same site: shared hostel dorm beds (mixed and female dormitories, 7 to 12 beds per room) and private apartments. Site available in Portuguese, Spanish, English, French, German and Italian.

## Key facts

- Check-in: from 2:00 PM. Check-out: by 12:00 PM. Reception is open until 10:00 PM; arrivals must be scheduled between 2 PM and 10 PM.
- Payment methods: credit card and PIX (PIX available for Brazilian residents). No installment payments.
- Group discounts: 10% off for 6+ beds, 15% off for 10+ beds. Groups can book entire dorms and split payment among members via a shareable link.
- Cancellation policy: the deposit paid at booking is non-refundable under any circumstance -- cancellation or no-show, regardless of notice.
- Free high-speed WiFi throughout. Shared kitchen available (breakfast is not included).
